data.completion_memo: Implemented the host’s frozen adapter descriptor registry and sole core-facing approved-invocation gateway. Admission rejects stale host generations, adapter version drift, unknown descriptors, and capability-kind substitution. cargo test -p aworkit-capability-host passes.
data.description: Implement the Capability Host's sole core-facing invocation gateway and generation-frozen adapter descriptor registry. Admit only schema-valid core-approved envelopes bound to the authenticated host generation and exact adapter version; reject live substitution, stale bindings, or any worker-originated channel.
data.title: M05.1 — Implement approved-invocation admission and adapter resolution
